title: Burgers & Brews — Dads
note: Dads: bring your kids and give moms the night off. The host is bringing the basics for Costco burgers and as much beer as fits in a single cooler, and cooking until they're all gone. Feel free to bring sides or drinks to share.
flyerAlt: Flyer for Burgers & Brews: October 3rd, 4:00 p.m. at Gardens Park. Bring your kids, give moms the night off. Costco burgers, cooking till they're gone. Feel free to bring sides or drinks to share. All families welcome, free to join.
price: Free to join — all families welcome

title: Free Toy Giveaway
note: Milestone Nonprofit Org is hosting a community giveaway at the Santa Clarita Valley Sheriff’s Station, 26201 Golden Valley Road. Visit their booth and pick up a brand-new toy and movie collectible: in the flyer’s words, “completely free for single family households, while supplies last.”
flyerAlt: Flyer: You are invited to a special community giveaway hosted by Milestone Nonprofit Org. Free toys and collectibles on October 18, 10 AM to 3 PM, at the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department in Santa Clarita. Everything on it is written out in the text beside it.
rsvpHead: Want to donate? Brand-new toys only
rsvp: Bring brand-new, unopened toys to 24229 Calle Oruga before the giveaway. Used toys can’t be accepted, because some of these go to hospitals. For the best time to drop off, message the organizer in the community group chat.
details: AMC Thousand Oaks, Sprouts Farmers Market – Valencia, and Farmer Boys – Valencia.
host: Hosted by Milestone Nonprofit Org, in partnership with the SCV Sheriff’s Station. This site only shares the details.

title: 2nd Annual Community Halloween Party
note: Neighbors, families and good times at Gardens Park on Avenida Sierra Madre: a jumper for the kids, ice cream, pizza for everyone, beer & wine for the adults, and a DJ for music and dancing.
flyerAlt: Flyer for the 2nd Annual Community Halloween Party: Friday, October 30, 6 to 10 PM at Gardens Park on Avenida Sierra Madre. Everything on it is written out in the text beside it.
priceNote: Your contribution covers the food, drinks, entertainment and activities for the evening.
rsvp: The limit is the park’s capacity. In the Zelle memo, include your family’s last name and how many adults and children are coming, so the committee can plan the right amount of food and drinks for each age group.
detailsLabel: 🏆 Costume contest · 🙋 Volunteer or bring something
details: Come dressed to impress! Prizes for Best Family/Group Costume, Scariest Costume, Most Creative Costume, and Best Kids' Costume.

Help is welcome: Halloween decor, a dish to share (a charcuterie board, cupcakes and the like), tables, chairs, or anything else that helps the evening. Message the organizer directly; they’re in the community group chat.
host: Run by the Tesoro Highlands event committee. This site only shares the details — payments and the guest list go through the committee.

title: Trick-or-Treat Night
note: Handing out treats? Put your house on the neighbors-only treat map (knock or ring, or candy out front) and flip it to out of candy when you're done. The code is in the community WhatsApp group.
